Clerics of Lolth have advantage on this Religion check.

notes: Place the ore in the crucible and the longsword mould in the mould chamber.
Lower the platform with the Forge Lever, open the Lava Valve, then use the Forge Lever to shape the item.
Retrieve the completed sword from the mould chamber.
Casting Arm Thy Servant creates the mace and immediately equips it on the caster.
Each caster can use Divine Intervention once during their adventure.

after.subject: Central-hole fall
after.value: The Matriarch’s corpse has fallen through the central hole into the Underdark

notes: The coordinates identify the Matriarch’s corpse, not the party’s landing point.
The recoverable route uses the central hole, which is not labelled Chasm; side pits labelled Chasm are not equivalent loot destinations.
Knocking the living Matriarch into these holes is blocked on both Tactician and Honour: she teleports back.
This restriction describes that living-knock method; other corpse-transfer methods and custom difficulty settings are not reviewed here.
